e: Detailed Explanation: Control over the purse remained constrained even at the provincial level: exactly 40 per cent of the total provincial budget was kept non-votable, maintaining bureaucratic insulation.

qe: The retrospective evaluation of the 1935 Act highlights that its narrow franchise guidelines enfranchised approximately what percentage of the total British Indian population?
qh: 1935 के अधिनियम का पूर्वव्यापी मूल्यांकन यह दर्शाता है कि इसके संकीर्ण मताधिकार दिशानिर्देशों ने कुल ब्रिटिश भारतीय आबादी के लगभग कितने प्रतिशत को मताधिकार दिया था?
o: 14 per cent
50 per cent
70 per cent
2 per cent
e: Detailed Explanation: Although the franchise was extended to wider sections and women got rights on the same basis as men, the qualifications remained restrictive, enfranchising a mere 14 per cent of the total British Indian population.

qe: What negative socio-political consequence did nationalist economic and political analysts attribute to the consolidation and extension of communal electorates under the 1935 Act?
qh: राष्ट्रवादी आर्थिक और राजनीतिक विश्लेषकों ने 1935 के अधिनियम के तहत सांप्रदायिक निर्वाचन क्षेत्रों के सुदृढ़ीकरण और विस्तार के लिए कौन सा नकारात्मक सामाजिक-राजनीतिक परिणाम जिम्मेदार माना?
o: It systematically promoted separatist tendencies which ultimately culminated in the partition of India
It successfully established a secular, classless society based on original democratic loops
It eliminated the dependency of local legislatures on the arbitrary vetoes of the Governor-General
It completely blocked the political standing of the conservative Aligarh school intellectuals
e: Detailed Explanation: The extension of communal and interest-based electorates under the 1935 framework deeply fractured the national fabric. Nationalists pointed out that it institutionalized divisions and promoted separatist tendencies that ultimately culminated in the partition of India.

qe: According to structural critiques, why did the Government of India Act 1935 function as a 'rigid constitution' with zero internal capacity for natural growth?
qh: संरचनात्मक आलोचनाओं के अनुसार, भारत सरकार अधिनियम 1935 ने प्राकृतिक विकास के लिए शून्य आंतरिक क्षमता के साथ एक 'कठोर संविधान' (rigid constitution) के रूप में क्यों काम किया?
o: The absolute right of constitutional amendment was reserved exclusively with the British Parliament
It gave the lower Federal Assembly absolute sovereign authority to alter any clause at will
The Act was legally forced to undergo a total public referendum across provinces every single year
It completely froze any future legislative changes from being passed by provincial councils
e: Detailed Explanation: The Act provided no mechanism for internal constitutional development. It was exceptionally rigid because the absolute right to amend or alter its provisions was kept exclusively in the hands of the British Parliament in London.

qe: From the perspective of long-term British colonial strategy, what was the primary political objective behind introducing the 1935 constitutional reforms?
qh: दीर्घकालिक ब्रिटिश औपनिवेशिक रणनीति के दृष्टिकोण से, 1935 के संवैधानिक सुधारों को पेश करने के पीछे प्राथमिक राजनीतिक उद्देश्य क्या था?
o: To weaken the national movement and integrate large segments of it into the colonial, administrative structure
To prepare a rapid administrative blueprint for transferring complete absolute sovereignty immediately
To completely eliminate the political influence of conservative loyalists and big landlords
To consolidate all regional trade unions into an independent anti-imperialist mass front
e: Detailed Explanation: The British recognized that long-term suppression was unsustainable. Their strategic goal behind the reforms was to weaken the intensity of the national movement by co-opting and integrating large segments of the leadership into the colonial constitutional and administrative network.

qe: The British strategists believed that once nationalist Congressmen entered office and tasted administrative power under the 1935 Act framework:
qh: ब्रिटिश रणनीतिकारों का मानना था कि एक बार जब राष्ट्रवादी कांग्रेसी पद संभाल लेंगे और 1935 के अधिनियम के ढांचे के तहत प्रशासनिक शक्ति का स्वाद चख लेंगे, तो:
o: They would become highly reluctant to go back to the challenging politics of sacrifice
They would immediately launch an armed mass revolution to seize the central executive council
They would completely liquidate all existing zamindari land revenue collection systems inside provinces
They would unify into a single integrated leftist bloc to crush the Moderate liberals
e: Detailed Explanation: A calculated aspect of the British strategy was psychological. They anticipated that once Congress leaders experienced the perks and authority of administrative power, they would be reluctant to abandon office and return to the challenging, self-denying politics of sacrifice.

qe: How did British policy-makers intend to utilize the provincial autonomy provisions to create deep organizational dissensions within the Indian National Congress high command?
qh: ब्रिटिश नीति-निर्माता भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस के उच्च कमान के भीतर गहरे संगठनात्मक मतभेद पैदा करने के लिए प्रांतीय स्वायत्तता के प्रावधानों का उपयोग कैसे करना चाहते थे?
o: By placating the right wing through constitutional concessions while using police measures to crush the radical leftists
By transferring the entire public finance portfolio exclusively to the control of the radical leftists
By legally forcing all Congress leaders to register their personal property assets inside London labs
By completely banning the Moderate liberals from contesting any provincial council elections
e: Detailed Explanation: The reforms were weaponized to split the nationalist front. The strategy aimed to satisfy and placate the conservative Right Wing of the Congress through constitutional concessions, while isolating and using police measures to crush the radical Leftists.

qe: British colonial authorities calculated that granting provincial autonomy would create powerful local leaders. What strategic impact did they expect this to have on the Congress?
qh: ब्रिटिश औपनिवेशिक अधिकारियों ने गणना की थी कि प्रांतीय स्वायत्तता देने से शक्तिशाली स्थानीय नेता पैदा होंगे। वे उम्मीद करते थे कि इसका कांग्रेस पर क्या रणनीतिक प्रभाव पड़ेगा?
o: The Congress would be provincialised and its centralized national leadership would get weakened
The central leadership would integrate tightly into an unstoppable anti-imperialist mass front
The Congress would immediately dissolve its provincial committees to form a single central cabinet
It would force the complete alignment of the party with the All India Muslim League core objectives
e: Detailed Explanation: The British calculated that provincial autonomy would turn local leaders into independent centers of political power. This would successfully 'provincialise' the Congress, distracting them with regional issues and effectively weakening the authority of the centralized national leadership.

qe: Which prominent colonial official candidly admitted the true strategic motive of the reforms by stating: 'We framed the Act of 1935 because we thought that was the best way...of maintaining British influence in India.'?
qh: किस प्रमुख औपनिवेशिक अधिकारी ने सुधारों के वास्तविक रणनीतिक उद्देश्य को स्पष्ट रूप से स्वीकार करते हुए कहा था: 'हमने 1935 का अधिनियम इसलिए बनाया क्योंकि हमने सोचा था कि भारत में ब्रिटिश प्रभाव को बनाए रखने का यह सबसे अच्छा तरीका है।'?
o: Viceroy Lord Linlithgow
Secretary of State Samuel Hoare
Prime Minister Ramsay MacDonald
Viceroy Lord Irwin
e: Detailed Explanation: Lord Linlithgow, who served as the Viceroy of India from 1936 to 1943, documented the underlying imperial intent, admitting that the 1935 Act was engineered primarily to safeguard and maintain British influence over the sub-continent.

qe: In his analytical critique of the 1935 Act, the constitutional historian B.R. Tomlinson observed that the entire process of constitutional advance in India was determined by what colonial need?
qh: 1935 के अधिनियम की अपनी विश्लेषणात्मक आलोचना में, संवैधानिक इतिहासकार बी.आर. टॉमलिंसन (B.R. Tomlinson) ने उल्लेख किया कि भारत में संवैधानिक प्रगति की पूरी प्रक्रिया किस औपनिवेशिक आवश्यकता से निर्धारित थी?
o: The need to attract Indian collaborators to the Raj
The urgent requirement to completely eliminate the economic drain of capital
The absolute necessity to introduce universal adult franchise across all colonies
The strategic goal of building up a highly sophisticated native steel industry
e: Detailed Explanation: B.R. Tomlinson's analysis exposed the co-optation model of the colonial state, noting that British constitutional concessions were structurally designed to attract and secure Indian collaborators to sustain the Raj's administrative existence.

qe: While the Indian National Congress unanimously rejected the 1935 Act, which political organizations declared themselves in favor of working its provisions at both the central and provincial levels?
qh: जबकि भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस ने सर्वसम्मति से 1935 के अधिनियम को खारिज कर दिया, किन राजनीतिक संगठनों ने इसके प्रावधानों को केंद्रीय और प्रांतीय दोनों स्तरों पर लागू करने (working the act) के पक्ष में घोषणा की थी?
o: The Hindu Mahasabha and the National Liberal Foundation
The Communist Party of India and the active trade unions
The All India Kisan Sabha and the Congress Leftist Faction
The radical student leagues and the Punjab Naujawan Bharat Sabha
e: Detailed Explanation: Breaking away from the radical rejectionist path of the Congress, both the Hindu Mahasabha and the National Liberal Foundation declared themselves in favor of participating in and working the machinery of the 1935 Act at all levels.

qe: Rejecting the unrepresentative 1935 Act framework, what alternative constitutional demand did the Indian National Congress aggressively present to the colonial state?
qh: अप्रतिनिधिक 1935 के अधिनियम के ढांचे को खारिज करते हुए, भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस ने औपनिवेशिक राज्य के सामने कौन सी वैकल्पिक संवैधानिक मांग आक्रामक रूप से रखी थी?
o: The convening of a Constituent Assembly elected on the basis of adult franchise to frame a constitution
The immediate legal restoration of the dual-rule system of Dyarchy across all provinces
A complete transfer of the absolute revenue command to the non-official members of the upper house
The mandatory structural partitioning of British India into separate linguistic segments instantly
e: Detailed Explanation: The Congress counter-attacked the colonial legislation by demanding that an independent Constituent Assembly, elected via universal adult franchise, must be convened to draft a sovereign constitution for a free India.

qe: A logistical coordinate charting system frames a precise right-angled triangular layout. A car leaves station O and travels 24 km North, and then changes course to drive 7 km East to reach checkpoint B. Find the absolute straight-line distance from O to B.
qh: एक वाहन स्टेशन O से निकलता है और 24 किमी उत्तर की ओर चलता है, और फिर दिशा बदलकर पूर्व की ओर 7 किमी जाकर चेकपॉइंट B पर पहुँचता है। O से B की सीधी रेखा की दूरी ज्ञात कीजिए।
o: 25 km
31 km
28 km
30 km
e:
Detailed Explanation: This spatial movement tracks a right-angled triangle with perpendicular legs measuring 24 km and 7 km. The direct straight-line distance represents the hypotenuse.
By applying the Pythagoras theorem: $\text{Distance} = \sqrt{24^2 + 7^2} = \sqrt{576 + 49} = \sqrt{625} = \mathbf{25\text{ km}}$.

qe: Before gaining prominence as an all-India leader, Subhash Chandra Bose served as the president of which provincial political organization?
qh: अखिल भारतीय नेता के रूप में प्रसिद्धि पाने से पहले, सुभाष चंद्र बोस ने किस प्रांतीय राजनीतिक संगठन के अध्यक्ष के रूप में कार्य किया था?
o: Bengal Provincial Congress Committee
Bombay Presidency Association
Madras Mahajan Sabha
Poona Sarvajanik Sabha
e: Detailed Explanation: Subhash Chandra Bose served as the president of the Bengal Provincial Congress Committee, where his primary focus was organizing the youth and expanding the trade union movement.

qe: Which political organization was established by Subhash Chandra Bose alongside Jawaharlal Nehru to advocate for absolute independence when older leaders favored dominion status?
qh: जब पुराने नेता डोमिनियन स्टेटस के पक्ष में थे, तब पूर्ण स्वतंत्रता की वकालत करने के लिए सुभाष चंद्र बोस ने जवाहरलाल नेहरू के साथ मिलकर किस राजनीतिक संगठन की स्थापना की थी?
o: Independence League
Forward Bloc
Swarajist Party
Indian League
e: Detailed Explanation: Dissatisfied with the Motilal Nehru Report's recommendation for dominion status, Subhash Chandra Bose and Jawaharlal Nehru organized the Independence League to demand complete independence.

qe: Subhash Chandra Bose vehemently opposed the signing of the Gandhi-Irwin Pact in 1931 primarily because the colonial government refused to compromise on which critical issue?
qh: सुभाष चंद्र बोस ने 1931 में गांधी-इरविन समझौते पर हस्ताक्षर करने का कड़ा विरोध मुख्य रूप से किस महत्वपूर्ण मुद्दे पर औपनिवेशिक सरकार के समझौता न करने के कारण किया था?
o: The death sentence of Bhagat Singh and his associates
The immediate abolition of the salt tax monopoly
The representation of depressed classes in legislatures
The dynamic introduction of provincial autonomy lists
e: Detailed Explanation: Bose was highly critical of the suspension of the Civil Disobedience Movement and the 1931 pact because the British administration flatly refused to negotiate on or commute the death sentences of Bhagat Singh, Sukhdev, and Rajguru.

qe: At the annual Congress session held at Haripura, Gujarat, in February 1938, Subhash Chandra Bose achieved what organizational milestone?
qh: फरवरी 1938 में हरिपुरा, गुजरात में आयोजित वार्षिक कांग्रेस अधिवेशन में सुभाष चंद्र बोस ने कौन सी संगठनात्मक उपलब्धि हासिल की थी?
o: He was unanimously elected as the President of the session
He formally announced his complete retirement from active politics
He established the Forward Bloc as a separate radical party
He dissolved the Bengal Provincial Congress Committee framework
e: Detailed Explanation: In February 1938, at the Haripura session in Gujarat, Subhash Chandra Bose was unanimously elected as the President of the Indian National Congress.

qe: In his 1938 Haripura presidential address, what progressive assessment did Subhash Chandra Bose outline regarding the Congress ministries running the provinces?
qh: अपने 1938 के हरिपुरा अध्यक्षीय भाषण में, सुभाष चंद्र बोस ने प्रांतों को चलाने वाले कांग्रेस मंत्रालयों के संबंध में क्या प्रगतिशील मूल्यांकन प्रस्तुत किया था?
o: He firmly believed that the provincial ministries possessed immense revolutionary potential
He declared that the ministries had completely outlived their baseline utility
He urged all popular premiums to immediately surrender their executive portfolios
He recommended that provincial budgets be placed under the direct control of the princes
e: Detailed Explanation: In his presidential address at Haripura, Bose expressed a firm belief that the newly formed Congress provincial ministries carried immense revolutionary potential for the freedom struggle.

qe: To map out the systematic economic development of India through state planning, Subhash Chandra Bose was instrumental in establishing which specialized body during his presidency?
qh: राज्य नियोजन के माध्यम से भारत के व्यवस्थित आर्थिक विकास का खाका तैयार करने के लिए, सुभाष चंद्र बोस ने अपनी अध्यक्षता के दौरान किस विशेष निकाय की स्थापना में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाई थी?
o: National Planning Committee
Decentralization Commission
Foreign Cloth Boycott Committee
Swarajya Sabha Council
e: Detailed Explanation: Strongly advocating for planned economic development, Bose was instrumental in setting up the National Planning Committee during his tenure as Congress president.

qe: What policy decision did the 1938 Haripura Congress session officially resolve regarding popular agitations erupting within the native Princely States?
qh: देशी रियासतों (Princely States) के भीतर भड़कने वाले जन आंदोलनों के संबंध में 1938 के हरिपुरा कांग्रेस सत्र ने आधिकारिक तौर पर क्या नीतिगत निर्णय लिया था?
o: The Congress would extend moral support to those agitating against governance in the princely states
The absolute military prohibition barring any nationalist intervention in the states
The mandatory structural merging of all states with the British provinces immediately
To provide financial credit subsidies to protect the rulers from peasant agitations
e: Detailed Explanation: The Haripura session adopted an important resolution declaring that the Congress would officially extend its moral support to democratic movements and agitations against the autocratic governance inside the princely states.

qe: When Subhash Chandra Bose decided to stand again for the post of Congress President in January 1939, which candidate was officially backed by Mahatma Gandhi and the conservative working committee?
qh: जब सुभाष चंद्र बोस ने जनवरी 1939 में फिर से कांग्रेस अध्यक्ष पद के लिए खड़े होने का फैसला किया, तो महात्मा गांधी और रूढ़िवादी कार्य समिति द्वारा आधिकारिक तौर पर किस उम्मीदवार का समर्थन किया गया था?
o: Pattabhi Sitaramayya
Rajendra Prasad
J.B. Kripalani
Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel
e: Detailed Explanation: Gandhi and several veteran members of the working committee opposed Bose's re-election bid, favoring and actively supporting Pattabhi Sitaramayya as their candidate.

qe: By what exact statistical margin did Subhash Chandra Bose win the historic presidential election of January 1939 against his opponent?
qh: सुभाष चंद्र बोस ने जनवरी 1939 के ऐतिहासिक राष्ट्रपति चुनाव में अपने प्रतिद्वंद्वी के खिलाफ किस सटीक सांख्यिकीय अंतर से जीत हासिल की थी?
o: 1580 votes against 1377
1377 votes against 1041
500 votes against 200
1650 votes against 1100
e: Detailed Explanation: In the closely contested January 1939 presidential election, Subhash Chandra Bose secured a historic victory by polling 1580 votes against Pattabhi Sitaramayya's 1377 votes.

qe: Which political blocs provided comprehensive strategic support to Subhash Chandra Bose during his victorious 1939 presidential election campaign?
qh: सुभाष चंद्र बोस को उनके विजयी 1939 के राष्ट्रपति चुनाव अभियान के दौरान किन राजनीतिक गुटों ने व्यापक रणनीतिक समर्थन प्रदान किया था?
o: The Congress Socialist Party and the communists
The National Liberal Foundation and the Hindu Mahasabha
The conservative Aligarh school elites and the Shafi League
The Unionists of Punjab and the Southern Justice Party
e: Detailed Explanation: Bose's re-election bid was strongly reinforced by the radical left wing, receiving full voting and organizational support from the Congress Socialist Party and the communists.

qe: Following the defeat of his preferred candidate in January 1939, Mahatma Gandhi issued which famous personal declaration that transformed the election into an internal ideological deadlock?
qh: जनवरी 1939 में अपने पसंदीदा उम्मीदवार की हार के बाद, महात्मा गांधी ने कौन सी प्रसिद्ध व्यक्तिगत घोषणा जारी की, जिसने चुनाव को एक आंतरिक वैचारिक गतिरोध में बदल दिया?
o: Pattabhi’s defeat is my defeat
India is one vast prison-house
No government deserves respect which holds cheap the liberty of its subjects
The process of constitutional advance is determined by the need to attract collaborators
e: Detailed Explanation: Conceding Sitaramayya's electoral loss, Gandhi publicly declared that 'Pattabhi’s defeat is my defeat,' transforming the political scenario into a direct Gandhi-versus-Bose ideological issue.

qe: In March 1939, the highly tense annual Congress session took place at Tripuri. Where is this historic location situated in present-day geography?
qh: मार्च 1939 में, त्रिपुरी में अत्यधिक तनावपूर्ण वार्षिक कांग्रेस सत्र आयोजित हुआ था। वर्तमान भूगोल में यह ऐतिहासिक स्थान कहाँ स्थित है?
o: Near Jabalpur in Madhya Pradesh
Near Wardha in Maharashtra
Near Unnao in Uttar Pradesh
Near Ahmedabad in Gujarat
e: Detailed Explanation: The Tripuri session of the Indian National Congress took place in the Central Provinces, located near Jabalpur in present-day Madhya Pradesh.

qe: Why was the election of the Congress President considered a vital constitutional opportunity for the broader membership inside the party structure?
qh: कांग्रेस अध्यक्ष के चुनाव को पार्टी संरचना के भीतर व्यापक सदस्यता के लिए एक महत्वपूर्ण संवैधानिक अवसर क्यों माना जाता था?
o: Because the Working Committee was nominated by the President, making the election an expression of the membership's preference for leadership
Because the President held absolute legal power to unilaterally amend the British Government of India Act
Because it was the only elective office that determined the allocation of central budget grants to local bodies
Because it allowed the winning candidate to automatically bypass any legislative vetoes of the Viceroy
e: Detailed Explanation: Since the ruling body of the Congress (the Working Committee) was nominated by the President rather than elected, the presidential election served as the single constitutional channel through which the general membership could dictate the ideological direction of the leadership.

qe: What serious accusation did Subhash Chandra Bose level against the veteran leaders of the Working Committee prior to the Tripuri session, precipitating their mass resignations?
qh: त्रिपुरी सत्र से पहले सुभाष चंद्र बोस ने कार्य समिति के अनुभवी नेताओं पर कौन सा गंभीर आरोप लगाया था, जिससे उनका सामूहिक इस्तीफा हुआ?
o: He accused them of being ready to reach a compromise with the colonial government on the matter of federation
He accused them of misappropriating the collected capital inputs of the Tilak Swaraj Fund
He claimed they were secretly operating as armed paramilitary commanders for the Chapekar brothers
He accused them of trying to enforce the mandatory use of English instead of vernaculars inside village schools
e: Detailed Explanation: Deepening the inner crisis, Bose publicly accused the old-guard Working Committee leaders of being willing to compromise with the British government regarding the implementation of the federal structure under the 1935 Act. Offended by these statements, those leaders resigned.

qe: In his presidential speech at Tripuri, what profound geopolitical event did Subhash Chandra Bose correctly prophesy was about to take place in Europe?
qh: त्रिपुरी में अपने अध्यक्षीय भाषण में, सुभाष चंद्र बोस ने सही ढंग से किस गंभीर भू-राजनीतिक घटना की भविष्यवाणी की थी जो यूरोप में होने वाली थी?
o: An imperialist war was about to take place in Europe
The complete financial collapse of the British Parliament exchequer lines
The unilateral entry of the Soviet Union into a maritime trading treaty with Japan
The total legal dissolution of all monarchical kingdoms across continental Europe
e: Detailed Explanation: Although attending the Tripuri session while heavily ill, Bose delivered a presidential speech in which he correctly predicted that an international imperialist war was imminent in Europe.

qe: What specific tactical measure did Subhash Chandra Bose advocate presenting to the British government during his presidential speech at Tripuri to secure Swaraj?
qh: सुभाष चंद्र बोस ने त्रिपुरी में अपने अध्यक्षीय भाषण के दौरान स्वराज प्राप्त करने के लिए ब्रिटिश सरकार के सामने कौन सा विशिष्ट रणनीतिक उपाय रखने की वकालत की थी?
o: Submitting the national demand of independence to the British government in the form of an ultimatum
Filing a joint civil properties injunction lawsuit inside the central legislative council rooms
The immediate voluntary dissolution of all provincial Congress committees and ministries
Requesting the Privy Council in London to expand the non-official advisory seats under the 1935 Act
e: Detailed Explanation: Bose urged that the Congress must leverage the international crisis by presenting India's national demand for independence to the British government in the form of a clear, definitive ultimatum.

qe: What duration did Subhash Chandra Bose propose for the ultimatum to Britain, resolving to launch a mass civil disobedience movement if it was rejected?
qh: सुभाष चंद्र बोस ने ब्रिटेन को दिए जाने वाले अल्टीमेटम के लिए कितनी अवधि प्रस्तावित की थी, और इसके अस्वीकार होने पर एक सामूहिक सविनय अवज्ञा आंदोलन शुरू करने का संकल्प लिया था?
o: A six-month ultimatum
A one-year ultimatum
A two-year grace period
A three-month emergency window
e: Detailed Explanation: Bose advocated giving a strict six-month ultimatum to Great Britain to grant independence, proposing that a nationwide mass civil disobedience movement be launched immediately if the timeline expired without a positive response.

qe: Why did Mahatma Gandhi strongly oppose Subhash Chandra Bose's proposal to deliver an immediate ultimatum to the British government in 1939?
qh: महात्मा गांधी ने 1939 में ब्रिटिश सरकार को तत्काल अल्टीमेटम देने के सुभाष चंद्र बोस के प्रस्ताव का कड़ा विरोध क्यों किया था?
o: He believed that neither the Congress nor the masses were ready for struggle, citing communal discord and class strife
He was legally bound by the terms of the Gandhi-Irwin Pact to protect British war interests indefinitely
He firmly believed that the Morley-Minto reforms fully satisfied all constitutional baseline demands
He sought to protect the economic profit margins of British managing agencies operating in coastal ports
e: Detailed Explanation: Gandhi rejected the ultimatum line because he felt the country was unready for a mass movement, noting visible communal discord, class strife, and a lack of a unified national vision that would jeopardize any immediate struggle.

qe: Which prominent leader moved a historic resolution at Tripuri that reaffirmed faith in Gandhian policies and mandated the President to nominate the Working Committee accordingly?
qh: किस प्रमुख नेता ने त्रिपुरी में एक ऐतिहासिक प्रस्ताव पेश किया जिसने गांधीवादी नीतियों में विश्वास दोहराया और राष्ट्रपति के लिए उसी के अनुसार कार्य समिति को नामित करना अनिवार्य बना दिया?
o: Govind Ballabh Pant
Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel
Rajendra Prasad
Pattabhi Sitaramayya
e: Detailed Explanation: Govind Ballabh Pant moved the controversial resolution at Tripuri, which re-emphasized complete faith in Gandhian principles and specifically directed Bose to select the members of the Working Committee in accordance with Gandhi's wishes.

qe: The 'Pant Resolution' at Tripuri was passed without opposition from the socialists or the communists. What did this reflect regarding the Left's strategic alignment?
qh: त्रिपुरी में 'पंत प्रस्ताव' समाजवादियों या कम्युनिस्टों के विरोध के बिना पारित हो गया था। इसने वामपंथ के रणनीतिक झुकाव (strategic alignment) के संबंध में क्या दर्शाया?
o: The Left was not keen on discarding Mahatma Gandhi's essential national leadership
The leftists had completely abandoned their belief in socialist and Marxist ideologies
They aimed to dissolve the Congress platform to fully integrate with the All India Muslim League
The Left held an absolute majority inside the non-elected Chamber of Princes
e: Detailed Explanation: The passage of the Pant Resolution proved that despite supporting Bose in the election, the Left wing was not ready to break away from or discard Mahatma Gandhi's crucial leadership of the broader national movement.

qe: Why did the socialists and the communists for the most part refuse to support Subhash Chandra Bose to the point of causing an absolute split within the Indian National Congress?
qh: समाजवादियों और कम्युनिस्टों ने अधिकांशतः सुभाष चंद्र बोस का उस सीमा तक समर्थन करने से क्यों इनकार कर दिया जिससे भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस के भीतर एक पूर्ण विभाजन हो जाता?
o: They realized that a split would reduce the un-consolidated Left to a minor splinter group and undermine the national struggle
They were financially dependent on the capital grant subsidies provided by the British War Cabinet
They were legally forced by an injunction of the central Legislative Assembly to support Rajendra Prasad
They believed that the varna system was completely sinful and required immediate armed annihilation
e: Detailed Explanation: Leftist groups recognized that their forces were not fully consolidated. They calculated that causing an institutional split within the Congress would reduce the Left to a minor splinter group and weaken the Congress, which was the primary vehicle of the anti-imperialist struggle.

qe: Faced with an absolute ideological deadlock and unable to win Gandhi's confidence or nominate a Working Committee, in which month and year did Subhash Chandra Bose resign from the post of Congress President?
qh: पूर्ण वैचारिक गतिरोध का सामना करने और गांधी का विश्वास जीतने या कार्य समिति को नामित करने में असमर्थ होने पर, सुभाष चंद्र बोस ने किस महीने और वर्ष में कांग्रेस अध्यक्ष पद से इस्तीफा दे दिया था?
o: April 1939
January 1939
March 1939
August 1939
e: Detailed Explanation: Seeing no alternative way to resolve the structural impasse or bridge his differences with Gandhi, Subhash Chandra Bose resigned from the presidency of the Congress in April 1939.

qe: Following the historic resignation of Subhash Chandra Bose in April 1939, who was elected as the new President to overcome the inner crisis of the Indian National Congress?
qh: अप्रैल 1939 में सुभाष चंद्र बोस के ऐतिहासिक इस्तीफे के बाद, भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस के आंतरिक संकट को दूर करने के लिए किसे नया अध्यक्ष चुना गया था?
o: Rajendra Prasad
Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel
J.B. Kripalani
Maulana Abul Kalam Azad
e: Detailed Explanation: To resolve the leadership vacuum and steady the party machinery after Bose's resignation, Dr. Rajendra Prasad was elected as the Congress President in April 1939.

qe: In May 1939, Subhash Chandra Bose and his radical followers established a new factional party within the broader framework of the Congress. What was its name and where was it founded?
qh: मई 1939 में, सुभाष चंद्र बोस और उनके कट्टरपंथी अनुयायियों ने कांग्रेस के व्यापक ढांचे के भीतर एक नए गुटीय दल की स्थापना की। इसका नाम क्या था और इसकी स्थापना कहाँ हुई थी?
o: Forward Bloc, founded at Makur, Unnao
Independence League, founded at Haripura, Gujarat
Naujawan Bharat Sabha, founded at Ferozshah Kotla, Delhi
Swarajya Sabha, founded at Wardha, Maharashtra
e: Detailed Explanation: In May 1939, Bose and his loyalists formed a specialized platform within the Congress infrastructure named the Forward Bloc, formally launched at Makur in the Unnao district of Uttar Pradesh.

qe: What provocative step taken by Subhash Chandra Bose in July 1939 against an official AICC resolution directly compelled the Working Committee to initiate strict disciplinary action against him?
qh: जुलाई 1939 में सुभाष चंद्र बोस द्वारा एक आधिकारिक एआईसीसी प्रस्ताव के खिलाफ उठाए गए किस उकसावे वाले कदम ने कार्य समिति को उनके खिलाफ सख्त अनुशासनात्मक कार्रवाई शुरू करने के लिए मजबूर किया था?
o: He gave a public call for an all-India protest on July 9
He ordered the immediate armed picketing of all provincial ministries
He forcefully seized the documented capital inputs of the National Planning Committee
He filed a direct property lawsuit inside the Calcutta High Court rooms against Rajendra Prasad
e: Detailed Explanation: Defying party lines, Bose organized a public call for a synchronized all-India protest on July 9 against an official resolution of the All India Congress Committee (AICC), prompting immediate disciplinary measures.

qe: In August 1939, the Congress Working Committee executed a severe disciplinary penalty against Subhash Chandra Bose. What was the nature of this penalty?
qh: अगस्त 1939 में, कांग्रेस कार्य समिति ने सुभाष चंद्र बोस के खिलाफ एक गंभीर अनुशासनात्मक दंड लागू किया। इस दंड की प्रकृति क्या थी?
o: He was removed from the post of president of the Bengal Provincial Congress Committee and debarred from holding any elective office in the Congress for three years
He was permanently excommunicated from entering any district within British India for life
His registered political journal 'Harijan' was summarily seized and its printing press liquidated
He was handed over to a special three-judge panel of the High Court to face a sedition trial
e: Detailed Explanation: In August 1939, the CWC penalized Bose by removing him from his position as president of the Bengal Provincial Congress Committee and legally debarring him from contesting or holding any elective post within the Congress for a fixed duration of three years.

qe: A survey routing pathway tracks a right-angled triangular configuration. A vehicle drives 24 km North from station O, and then shifts orientation to move 10 km East to reach checkpoint B. Find the direct straight-line distance from O to B.
qh: एक कार स्टेशन O से 24 किमी उत्तर की ओर चलती है, और फिर दिशा बदलकर पूर्व की ओर 10 किमी जाकर चेकपॉइंट B पर पहुँचती है। O से B की सीधी रेखा की दूरी ज्ञात कीजिए।
o: 26 km
34 km
28 km
30 km
e:
Detailed Explanation: This spatial movement sets up a right-angled triangle with perpendicular legs of 24 km and 10 km. The direct straight-line distance represents the hypotenuse.
By applying the Pythagoras theorem: $\text{Distance} = \sqrt{24^2 + 10^2} = \sqrt{576 + 100} = \sqrt{676} = \mathbf{26\text{ km}}$.

qe: In a biological ecosystem productivity tracking survey mapping energy parameters, if the Gross Primary Productivity (GPP) of an alluvial marsh plain is 35,000 units and the energy lost during plant metabolic respiration (R) is 15,000 units, calculate the Net Primary Productivity (NPP).
qh: ऊर्जा मापदंडों का मानचित्रण करने वाले एक पारिस्थितिकी उत्पादकता सर्वेक्षण में, यदि एक मैदानी क्षेत्र की सकल प्राथमिक उत्पादकता (GPP) 35,000 इकाइयाँ है और पौधों के श्वसन (R) के दौरान खर्च की गई ऊर्जा 15,000 इकाइयाँ है, तो शुद्ध प्राथमिक उत्पादकता (NPP) की गणना करें।
o: 20,000 units
50,000 units
15,000 units
30,000 units
e:
Detailed Explanation: Utilizing the core ecological productivity balance formula: $NPP = GPP - R$.
Substituting the values: $NPP = 35,000 - 15,000 = \mathbf{20,000\text{ units}}$.

qe: Sardar Patel, Rajendra Prasad, and J.B. Kripalani argued against Bose's view of the presidency by asserting that the position of the Congress President structurally served what primary role?
qh: सरदार पटेल, राजेंद्र प्रसाद और जे.बी. कृपलानी ने राष्ट्रपति पद के संबंध में बोस के दृष्टिकोण का विरोध करते हुए दावा किया कि कांग्रेस अध्यक्ष का पद संरचनात्मक रूप से किस प्राथमिक भूमिका को पूरा करता था?
o: It was more of a constitutional post, representative and symbolic of the unity of the nation
It was an absolute dictatorial office equipped with direct veto powers over all provincial list charts
It functioned strictly as an intermediate financial accounting office managing the home charges bills
It was a lifetime hereditary title reserved exclusively for Western-educated barristers of Calcutta
e: Detailed Explanation: Defending traditional norms, Patel and other working committee leaders argued that programs were developed collectively in bodies like the working committee, and the President's post was a constitutional, representative position symbolic of national unity.

qe: In his analytical view written later, why did Subhash Chandra Bose believe that the international crisis of 1939 was the absolute optimum time to strike against British imperialism?
qh: बाद में लिखे गए अपने विश्लेषणात्मक दृष्टिकोण में, सुभाष चंद्र बोस का यह क्यों मानना था कि 1939 का अंतर्राष्ट्रीय संकट ब्रिटिश साम्राज्यवाद के खिलाफ प्रहार करने का बिल्कुल उपयुक्त समय था?
o: He believed the Congress was structurally strong enough and the masses were completely ready for such a struggle
He calculated that the British exchequer was totally bankrupt and unable to deploy any police forces
He believed that the separate communal electorates framework had successfully unified all rural ryots
He felt that the Viceroy's executive council would voluntarily surrender all its powers without a fight
e: Detailed Explanation: Bose's radical strategy was anchored on a confident assessment of mass readiness. He maintained that the Congress possessed sufficient structural strength and that the public was fully prepared to launch a final mass civil disobedience campaign to wrest independence while Britain was vulnerable during the European crisis.

qe: Following the departure of the Cripps Mission, Mahatma Gandhi framed a historic resolution. What dual call did this resolution present to the nationalist ranks?
qh: क्रिप्स मिशन की विदाई के बाद, महात्मा गांधी ने एक ऐतिहासिक प्रस्ताव तैयार किया। इस प्रस्ताव ने राष्ट्रवादी रैंकों के सामने कौन सा दोहरा आह्वान प्रस्तुत किया?
o: A call for British withdrawal and a non-violent non-cooperation movement against any Japanese invasion
The immediate structural merging of all princely states with the British provinces
A total permanent legal ban on publishing any regional vernacular media sheets
The mandatory recruitment of all Congress volunteers into the British War Cabinet
e: Detailed Explanation: After the failure of the Cripps Mission, Gandhi formulated a resolution calling for the immediate withdrawal of British power from India and outlining a non-violent non-cooperation strategy to resist any potential Japanese invasion.

qe: The Congress Working Committee met at a specific location in July 1942 and officially accepted the idea of launching a mass struggle. Where did this historic meeting take place?
qh: कांग्रेस कार्य समिति ने जुलाई 1942 में एक विशिष्ट स्थान पर बैठक की और सामूहिक संघर्ष शुरू करने के विचार को आधिकारिक रूप से स्वीकार कर लिया। यह ऐतिहासिक बैठक कहाँ हुई थी?
o: Wardha
Bombay
Calcutta
Tripuri
e: Detailed Explanation: The Congress Working Committee met at Wardha on July 14, 1942, where it deeply debated the political situation and accepted the foundational idea of launching a mass struggle against colonial rule.

qe: During the run-up to the 1942 upsurge, intense popular discontent erupted due to severe post-war economic distress. Which supply shortage heavily fueled this rural distress?
qh: 1942 के उभार की तैयारी के दौरान, युद्धोत्तर गंभीर आर्थिक संकट के कारण तीव्र जन असंतोष भड़क उठा। किस आपूर्ति की कमी ने इस ग्रामीण संकट को भारी बढ़ावा दिया?
o: Rising prices and shortage of rice, salt, and essential commodities
A sudden volumetric drop in the availability of imported British machinery
The complete operational closure of all national school training facilities
A sudden scarcity of non-ionic liquid chemical fertilizers across plains
e: Detailed Explanation: Rural and urban classes alike faced severe economic hardships, driven by rapidly rising commodity prices and acute shortages of essential daily items like rice and salt.

qe: Nationalists feared that the British administration would implement a destructive scorched-earth policy in eastern provinces to block a Japanese advance. In which regions was this fear most prevalent?
qh: राष्ट्रवादियों को डर था कि ब्रिटिश प्रशासन जापानी सेना को रोकने के लिए पूर्वी प्रांतों में विनाशकारी 'झुलसी हुई धरती' (scorched-earth) की नीति लागू करेगा। यह डर किन क्षेत्रों में सबसे अधिक व्याप्त था?
o: Assam, Bengal, and Orissa
Punjab, Sindh, and Baluchistan
Bombay, Madras, and Mysore
The Central Provinces and United Provinces subdivisions
e: Detailed Explanation: Due to the imminent threat of a Japanese military advance, the public feared that the retreating British army would implement a scorched-earth policy in Assam, Bengal, and Orissa, destroying local resources and infrastructure.

qe: Popular faith in the stability of British rule crashed to an all-time low during 1942. What financial panic behavior manifested this lack of public confidence?
qh: 1942 के दौरान ब्रिटिश शासन की स्थिरता में जनविश्वास अब तक के सबसे निचले स्तर पर आ गया। सार्वजनिक आत्मविश्वास की इस कमी को किस वित्तीय पैनिक व्यवहार ने प्रकट किया?
o: People were rapidly withdrawing their deposits from banks and post offices
The immediate conversion of all fiat currency notes into raw cotton shipments
A total structural boycott of all indigenous joint-stock corporate banks
The universal transfer of private wealth directly to the Tilak Swaraj Fund
e: Detailed Explanation: As news of British military reverses in South-East Asia spread, public confidence in the survival of the Raj collapsed, prompting panicked citizens to rapidly withdraw their financial savings from government-controlled banks and post offices.

qe: The evacuation methodology executed by the British during their retreat from South-East Asia deeply shattered white prestige by exposing a blatantly racist attitude. What discriminatory feature characterized this evacuation?
qh: दक्षिण-पूर्व एशिया से पीछे हटने के दौरान अंग्रेजों द्वारा अपनाई गई निकासी कार्यप्रणाली ने घोर नस्लवादी रवैये को उजागर करके श्वेत प्रतिष्ठा को गहरा आघात पहुँचाया। इस निकासी की क्या भेदभावपूर्ण विशेषता थी?
o: Providing two separate evacuation routes: a Black Road for Indian refugees and a White Road exclusively for European refugees
Forcing all Indian origin refugees to pay a heavy transit tax surcharge in cash
The total structural exclusion of any non-official British subject from shipping lines
Mandatory translation of all transit identity tokens into English characters exclusively
e: Detailed Explanation: The colonial authorities maintained separate evacuation routes: a poorly maintained 'Black Road' for Indian refugees and a privileged 'White Road' reserved exclusively for European refugees, exposing the deeply rooted racist attitude of the rulers.

qe: The historic resolution generally referred to as the 'Quit India' resolution was formally proposed and seconded by which duo of legendary leaders at the Wardha meeting?
qh: ऐतिहासिक प्रस्ताव जिसे आमतौर पर 'भारत छोड़ो' (Quit India) प्रस्ताव कहा जाता है, वर्धा बैठक में दिग्गज नेताओं की किस जोड़ी द्वारा औपचारिक रूप से प्रस्तावित और समर्थित किया गया था?
o: Proposed by Jawaharlal Nehru and seconded by Sardar Patel
Proposed by Mahatma Gandhi and seconded by Maulana Azad
Proposed by C.R. Das and seconded by Motilal Nehru
Proposed by Subhash Chandra Bose and seconded by Acharya Kripalani
e: Detailed Explanation: The 'Quit India' text resolution was drafted and formally proposed by Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru and seconded by Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel at the Wardha Working Committee assembly.

qe: At which landmark location in Bombay was the Quit India Resolution officially ratified by the All India Congress Committee on August 8, 1942?
qh: बॉम्बे में किस ऐतिहासिक स्थान पर 8 अगस्त, 1942 को अखिल भारतीय कांग्रेस समिति द्वारा भारत छोड़ो प्रस्ताव को आधिकारिक रूप से मंजूरी दी गई थी?
o: Gowalia Tank
Calcutta Townhall premises
Sabarmati Ashram grounds
Fergusson College square
e: Detailed Explanation: The All India Congress Committee met in a historic assembly at Gowalia Tank, Bombay, where they formally ratified the Quit India Resolution on August 8, 1942.

qe: Which of the following baseline commitments was NOT explicitly incorporated within the text of the historic Quit India Resolution ratified on August 8, 1942?
qh: 8 अगस्त, 1942 को स्वीकृत ऐतिहासिक भारत छोड़ो प्रस्ताव के पाठ के भीतर निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी बुनियादी प्रतिबद्धता स्पष्ट रूप से शामिल नहीं थी?
o: To accept a constitution based on Dominion Status within the British Commonwealth framework
To demand an immediate end to British rule in India
To declare the commitment of free India to defend itself against all types of Fascism and imperialism
To sanction a civil disobedience movement against British rule
e: Detailed Explanation: The 1942 resolution completely discarded old compromise goals. It explicitly demanded an immediate end to British rule, sanctioned a massive civil disobedience campaign, and declared free India's commitment to resist Fascism and imperialism.

qe: Under the specific directives framed for government servants by Mahatma Gandhi during the 1942 mobilization, what action were they instructed to take?
qh: 1942 के लामबंदी के दौरान महात्मा गांधी द्वारा सरकारी कर्मचारियों के लिए तैयार किए गए विशिष्ट निर्देशों के तहत, उन्हें क्या कार्रवाई करने का निर्देश दिया गया था?
o: Do not resign from your posts but declare your allegiance to the Congress
Resign from your administrative positions immediately and move to villages
Refuse to collect any land revenue taxes from the local zamindars
Submit all official communications to a special three-judge panel of the High Court
e: Detailed Explanation: Modifying older non-cooperation instructions, Gandhi directed government servants not to resign their administrative seats immediately, but to boldly declare their open political allegiance to the Congress.

qe: What specific operational instruction did Mahatma Gandhi formulate for the soldiers serving within the British Indian Army during his Gowalia Tank guidelines?
qh: महात्मा गांधी ने अपने गोवालिया टैंक दिशानिर्देशों के दौरान ब्रिटिश भारतीय सेना के भीतर सेवा कर रहे सैनिकों के लिए कौन सा विशिष्ट परिचालन निर्देश तैयार किया था?
o: Do not leave the Army but do not fire on compatriots
Mutiny immediately, seize the local arsenals, and execute the European officers
Resign your military commissions and migrate permanently toward the western coast
Refuse to obey any strategic deployment orders relating to the Japanese advance
e: Detailed Explanation: For the armed forces, Gandhi's guideline stated that soldiers should retain their seats inside the Army but firmly refuse to obey any orders to open fire on their own compatriots.

qe: Under the tactical rent-payment guidelines designed for the peasantry during the 1942 struggle, what action was advised if a zamindar was pro-government?
qh: 1942 के संघर्ष के दौरान किसानों के लिए तैयार किए गए रणनीतिक किराया-भुगतान (rent-payment) दिशानिर्देशों के तहत, यदि कोई जमींदार सरकार समर्थक था, तो क्या कार्रवाई करने की सलाह दी गई थी?
o: Do not pay any rent to the zamindar
Pay a mutually agreed rent directly to the Congress volunteer corps
File a joint civil property lawsuit inside the Zila court rooms
Surrender half of the agricultural crop yield to the local sub-divisional magistrate
e: Detailed Explanation: Gandhi's agrarian directives split the tactics based on political alignment: if a landlord was anti-government, tenants should pay mutually agreed rent; but if the zamindar was pro-government, peasants were instructed to withhold rent entirely.

qe: What precise directive did Mahatma Gandhi convey to the sovereign rulers of the native Princely States during his general instructions?
qh: महात्मा गांधी ने अपने सामान्य निर्देशों के दौरान देशी रियासतों के संप्रभु शासकों को क्या सटीक निर्देश दिया था?
o: Support the masses and accept the sovereignty of your own people
Surrender your entire treasury to the British War Cabinet immediately
Abolish all representative assemblies operating within your territorial borders
Flee to neutral European capitals to escape the Japanese invasion threat
e: Detailed Explanation: Gandhi called upon the princes to read the writing on the wall, instructing them to support the anti-colonial mass upsurge and formally acknowledge the ultimate political sovereignty of their own people.

qe: The people residing within the native Princely States were instructed to support their local rulers under what specific condition?
qh: देशी रियासतों के भीतर रहने वाले लोगों को किस विशिष्ट शर्त के तहत अपने स्थानीय शासकों का समर्थन करने का निर्देश दिया गया था?
o: Support the ruler only if he is anti-government and declare yourselves to be a part of the Indian nation
Support the ruler unconditionally if he maintains separate communal electorates
Provide military backing to the ruler if he signs a corporate treaty with British managing agencies
Only if the ruler completely abolishes any land revenue collections inside the state
e: Detailed Explanation: The state subjects were instructed to extend loyalty to their prince only if he was anti-government, and they were directed to boldly declare themselves an integral part of the sovereign Indian nation.

qe: Mahatma Gandhi delivered a powerful, historic mantra to the nation during the Gowalia Tank mobilization. What was this famous exhortation?
qh: महात्मा गांधी ने गोवालिया टैंक लामबंदी के दौरान राष्ट्र को एक शक्तिशाली, ऐतिहासिक मंत्र दिया था। यह प्रसिद्ध उद्घोष क्या था?
o: Do or Die
No taxation without representation
Political freedom is the lifebreath of a nation
Humanism is a special virtue of a revolutionary
e: Detailed Explanation: Gandhi delivered his definitive, immortal mantra to the country: 'Do or Die'. He explained that Indians must either achieve the total liberation of the country or perish in the attempt, refusing to live to see the perpetuation of slavery.

qe: In the early hours of August 9, 1942, the colonial government launched a massive preemptive sweep. What legal action was taken against the top Congress committees?
qh: 9 अगस्त, 1942 के शुरुआती घंटों में औपनिवेशिक सरकार ने एक बड़ा पूर्व-निवारक (preemptive) दमन शुरू किया। शीर्ष कांग्रेस समितियों के खिलाफ क्या कानूनी कार्रवाई की गई थी?
o: They were declared unlawful associations under the Criminal Law Amendment Act of 1908
They were structurally merged into the non-elected Chamber of Princes
They were placed under the direct operational command of the High Court judges panel
Their corporate financial assets were completely transferred to the London British exchequer
e: Detailed Explanation: To crush the movement before it could begin, the state arrested all frontline leaders on the morning of August 9, 1942, and formally outlawed the CWC, AICC, and Provincial Congress Committees under the provisions of the Criminal Law Amendment Act of 1908.

qe: Under which specific statutory regulation was the assembly of public protest meetings completely prohibited by the state in August 1942?
qh: अगस्त 1942 में राज्य द्वारा किस विशिष्ट वैधानिक नियम के तहत सार्वजनिक विरोध बैठकों के आयोजन को पूरी तरह से प्रतिबंधित कर दिया गया था?
o: Rule 56 of the Defence of India Rules
Section 124A of the Indian Penal Code
The Seditious Meetings Act of 1907
The permanent clauses of the Rowlatt Act framework
e: Detailed Explanation: To prevent public mobilization and street processions, the administration strictly prohibited all public assemblies by invoking Rule 56 of the Defence of India Rules.

qe: With the frontline leadership imprisoned, which relatively unknown younger nationalist leader presided over the Congress committee session on August 9, 1942, and courageously hoisted the flag?
qh: अग्रिम पंक्ति के नेतृत्व के जेल में होने के कारण, किस अपेक्षाकृत अज्ञात युवा राष्ट्रवादी नेता ने 9 अगस्त, 1942 को कांग्रेस समिति के सत्र की अध्यक्षता की और साहसपूर्वक झंडा फहराया था?
o: Aruna Asaf Ali
Sucheta Kripalani
Usha Mehta
Pritilata Waddedar
e: Detailed Explanation: The sudden arrest of established leaders left a vacuum. Aruna Asaf Ali stepped forward, presided over the session on August 9 at Gowalia Tank, and hoisted the national tricolor flag, signaling the start of the mass resistance.

qe: The public upsurge across India targeted symbols of colonial authority. In which two geographical regions was this direct public sabotage and rampage most intense?
qh: भारत भर में जनता के उभार ने औपनिवेशिक सत्ता के प्रतीकों को निशाना बनाया। यह प्रत्यक्ष सार्वजनिक तोड़फोड़ और उपद्रव किन दो भौगोलिक क्षेत्रों में सबसे तीव्र था?
o: Eastern United Provinces and Bihar
The Malabar district of Kerala and Guntur plain
The coastal maritime towns of Surat and Bombay city
The interior tribal tracts of the Central Provinces
e: Detailed Explanation: Left leaderless, the general public attacked infrastructure like railways and telegraphs. This intense phase of open rebellion was most severe and concentrated across eastern United Provinces and Bihar.

qe: How did student youth dynamically respond during the expansion of the 1942 anti-colonial mass movement?
qh: 1942 के औपनिवेशिक विरोधी जन आंदोलन के विस्तार के दौरान छात्र युवाओं ने कैसी गतिशील प्रतिक्रिया दी?
o: By going on strike, participating in processions, distributing illegal news sheets (patrikas), and acting as couriers
By filing thousands of property injunction lawsuits inside the Calcutta High Court rooms
By translating British administrative codes into classical Sanskrit loops inside libraries
By voluntarily enrolling into the military recruitment channels managed by Michael O'Dwyer
e: Detailed Explanation: Students served as the frontline cadres of the movement. They boycotted institutions, led protest marches, published and distributed underground political sheets (patrikas), and ran communication lines for underground networks.

qe: Industrial working-class workers launched massive strikes in solidarity with the 1942 struggle. Which of the following sets of cities experienced these labor strikes?
qh: औद्योगिक मजदूर वर्ग के श्रमिकों ने 1942 के संघर्ष के समर्थन में बड़े पैमाने पर हड़तालें शुरू कीं। निम्नलिखित में से किस शहर के समूह ने इन श्रम हड़तालों का अनुभव किया?
o: Ahmedabad, Bombay, Jamshedpur, Ahmednagar, and Poona
Calcutta, Dacca, Murshidabad, and Chittagong exclusively
Madras, Guntur, Salem, and Tuticorin coastal ports
Rawalpindi, Lahore, Amritsar, and Delhi municipality bounds
e: Detailed Explanation: The working class shut down vital manufacturing centers in support of the Quit India call. Major labor strikes erupted across Ahmedabad, Bombay, Jamshedpur (Tata steel plants), Ahmednagar, and Poona.

qe: A highly resilient cadre of nationalists went underground to maintain public morale and provide a continuous line of command. Which group of leaders provided the core personality tracking for this underground activity?
qh: राष्ट्रवादियों के एक अत्यधिक जुझारू कैडर ने जन मनोबल बनाए रखने और कमान की एक निरंतर रेखा प्रदान करने के लिए भूमिगत (underground) गतिविधियों का सहारा लिया। नेताओं के किस समूह ने इस भूमिगत गतिविधि को मुख्य रूप से संचालित किया?
o: Rammanohar Lohia, Jayaprakash Narayan, Aruna Asaf Ali, Usha Mehta, and Biju Patnaik
Surendranath Banerjea, Ananda Mohan Bose, and Sisir Kumar Ghosh
M. Viraraghavachari, B. Subramaniya Aiyar, and P. Anandacharlu
Dadabhai Naoroji, Dinshaw Wacha, and W.C. Bonnerjee
e: Detailed Explanation: Underground operations kept the resistance alive. The prominent personalities who coordinated these networks, distributed materials, and directed cadres included Rammanohar Lohia, Jayaprakash Narayan, Aruna Asaf Ali, Usha Mehta, Biju Patnaik, Achyut Patwardhan, and Sucheta Kripalani.

qe: Who among the prominent underground women nationalists masterminded and successfully operated an illegal secret underground radio transmitter in Bombay?
qh: प्रमुख भूमिगत महिला राष्ट्रवादियों में से किसने बॉम्बे में एक अवैध गुप्त भूमिगत रेडियो ट्रांसमीटर का सफलतापूर्वक संचालन किया था?
o: Usha Mehta
Aruna Asaf Ali
Sucheta Kripalani
Kalpana Dutt
e: Detailed Explanation: In a spectacular act of technological defiance, Usha Mehta established and operated a clandestine secret underground radio station in Bombay to broadcast news of the movement and maintain public morale.

qe: In August 1942, a parallel government was successfully established for a week in Ballia. Who was the popular nationalist leader who headed this independent administration?
qh: अगस्त 1942 में, बलिया में एक सप्ताह के लिए एक समानांतर सरकार (parallel government) सफलतापूर्वक स्थापित की गई थी। इस स्वतंत्र प्रशासन के प्रमुख लोकप्रिय राष्ट्रवादी नेता कौन थे?
o: Chittu Pandey
Nana Patil
Y.B. Chavan
Acharya Narendra Dev
e: Detailed Explanation: The collapse of British authority in parts of UP led to the creation of independent local administrations. In Ballia, a parallel government was set up in August 1942 under Chittu Pandey, who successfully forced the release of local Congress leaders.

qe: The long-lived parallel government named the 'Jatiya Sarkar' undertook cyclone relief work, organized 'Vidyut Vahinis', and supplied grain to the poor. In which specific region was it established?
qh: लंबे समय तक चलने वाली समानांतर सरकार जिसे 'जातीय सरकार' (Jatiya Sarkar) कहा जाता है, ने चक्रवात राहत कार्य शुरू किया, 'विद्युत वाहिनी' का आयोजन किया और गरीबों को अनाज की आपूर्ति की। यह किस विशिष्ट क्षेत्र में स्थापित की गई थी?
o: Tamluk (Midnapore)
Satara
Ballia
Hazaribagh
e: Detailed Explanation: In Tamluk, Midnapore (Bengal), an independent 'Jatiya Sarkar' functioned successfully from December 1942 to September 1944. It established an organized administration, ran cyclone relief operations, and structured voluntary defense corps named Vidyut Vahinis.

qe: The parallel government named 'Prati Sarkar' was organized from mid-1943 to 1945, establishing village libraries, running prohibition campaigns, and organizing 'Gandhi marriages'. In which district did this happen?
qh: 1943 के मध्य से 1945 तक 'प्रति सरकार' (Prati Sarkar) नामक समानांतर सरकार का आयोजन किया गया था, जिसने ग्रामीण पुस्तकालयों की स्थापना की, निषेध अभियान चलाया और 'गांधी विवाह' का आयोजन किया। यह किस जिले में हुआ था?
o: Satara
Ballia
Midnapore
Gorakhpur
e: Detailed Explanation: In Satara (Maharashtra), a highly resilient parallel administration named 'Prati Sarkar' was organized under leaders like Y.B. Chavan and Nana Patil, running judicial bodies (Nyayadan Mandals) and social welfare campaigns.

qe: Different sections of society extended quiet structural help to the underground activists. How did professional transport workers like train drivers and pilots assist the movement?
qh: समाज के विभिन्न वर्गों ने भूमिगत कार्यकर्ताओं को शांत संरचनात्मक सहायता प्रदान की। ट्रेन ड्राइवरों और पायलटों जैसे पेशेवर परिवहन कर्मचारियों ने आंदोलन में कैसे मदद की थी?
o: By delivering bombs and other sabotage materials across lines
By passing on secret intelligence codes directly to the High Court judges
By strictly enforcing the segregation of European refugees along White roads
By collecting financial registration security fees for the Forward Bloc
e: Detailed Explanation: The anti-colonial defiance permeated deep into the working class. Train drivers and pilots actively abetted underground cells by surreptitiously transporting and delivering explosive materials, bombs, and message sheets across regions.

qe: When evaluating peasant participation during the 1942 mass movement, what unique structural feature characterized their offensive parameters?
qh: 1942 के जन आंदोलन के दौरान किसानों की भागीदारी का मूल्यांकन करते समय, उनके आक्रामक मानकों (offensive parameters) की कौन सी अनूठी संरचनात्मक विशेषता थी?
o: They concentrated their offensive on symbols of authority, and there was a complete absence of anti-zamindar violence
They executed an immediate armed class war to eliminate all intermediate landlords
They refused to allow lower-class student volunteers to enter their crop fields
They aligned their local councils entirely with the pro-government Unionist party
e: Detailed Explanation: Unlike earlier agrarian unrests, peasant militancy during Quit India was focused strictly on symbols of the colonial state (police stations, post offices). Even though all strata of peasants participated, class war was avoided, and there was a complete absence of violence against landlords.

qe: Why did the Communist Party of India consciously choose NOT to participate in or support the Quit India Movement in 1942, breaking away from the nationalist consensus?
qh: भारतीय कम्युनिस्ट पार्टी (CPI) ने 1942 में भारत छोड़ो आंदोलन में भाग न लेने या उसका समर्थन न करने का सचेत निर्णय क्यों चुना, जिससे वह राष्ट्रवादी आम सहमति से अलग हो गई?
o: Following the Nazi attack on Soviet Russia, they began supporting the British war effort, re-branding the 'Imperialist War' as the 'People's War'
They were legally barred by a direct text decree passed by the central legislative assembly majority
The leadership voluntarily dissolved its framework to integrate with the Hindu Mahasabha front
They demanded that the movement must adopt English exclusively as its programmatic medium
e: Detailed Explanation: The CPI's stance was dictated by international alignments. When Nazi Germany attacked the Soviet Union (the communist homeland), the CPI changed its line from opposing the British to supporting the Allied war effort, declaring the conflict a 'People's War' and refusing to back the Quit India struggle.

qe: What primary political fear caused the All India Muslim League to formally oppose the launch of the Quit India Movement in 1942?
qh: किस प्राथमिक राजनीतिक भय के कारण अखिल भारतीय मुस्लिम लीग ने 1942 में भारत छोड़ो आंदोलन शुरू करने का औपचारिक विरोध किया था?
o: They feared that if the British left India at that time, the minorities would be heavily oppressed by the Hindu majority
They calculated that the Japanese military forces would immediately establish an Islamic caliphate
The leadership was committed to protecting the economic interests of British managing agencies
They objected to the resolution's demand to completely abolish separate electorates framework
e: Detailed Explanation: The Muslim League opposed the movement and stood aloof because they feared a sudden British withdrawal without a prior communal settlement would leave the Muslim minority vulnerable to majoritarian Hindu domination.

qe: In a biological survey tracking energy flow metrics within a terrestrial ecosystem, if the Gross Primary Productivity (GPP) of an alluvial marsh plain accumulates to 48,000 units and the energy spent during metabolic plant respiration (R) is 20,000 units, calculate the Net Primary Productivity (NPP).
qh: एक पारिस्थितिकी जैविक सर्वेक्षण में, यदि एक मैदानी क्षेत्र की सकल प्राथमिक उत्पादकता (GPP) 48,000 इकाइयाँ संचित होती है और पौधों के श्वसन (R) के दौरान खर्च की गई ऊर्जा 20,000 इकाइयाँ है, तो शुद्ध प्राथमिक उत्पादकता (NPP) की गणना करें।
o: 28,000 units
68,000 units
30,000 units
18,000 units
e:
Detailed Explanation: Utilizing the core ecological productivity balance formula: $NPP = GPP - R$.
Substituting the given variables: $NPP = 48,000 - 20,000 = \mathbf{28,000\text{ units}}$.

qe: Although martial law was not formally applied, the colonial government unleashed brutal repression to crush the 1942 upsurge. What is the estimated number of citizens killed in state firings?
qh: हालांकि मार्शल लॉ औपचारिक रूप से लागू नहीं किया गया था, फिर भी औपनिवेशिक सरकार ने 1942 के उभार को कुचलने के लिए क्रूर दमन का सहारा लिया। सरकारी गोलीबारी में मारे गए नागरिकों की अनुमानित संख्या कितनी है?
o: 10,000 killed
379 killed
1,500 killed
1,650 killed
e: Detailed Explanation: The state responded with extreme violence. Crowds were machine-gunned from the air and fired upon in streets, with the estimated death toll reaching approximately 10,000 citizens.

qe: From an analytical perspective, what primary long-term truth did the unparalleled heroism and spontaneity of the Quit India Movement establish regarding British rule?
qh: विश्लेषणात्मक दृष्टिकोण से, भारत छोड़ो आंदोलन के अभूतपूर्व वीरता और स्वतःस्फूर्तता ने ब्रिटिश शासन के संबंध में कौन सा प्राथमिक दीर्घकालिक सत्य स्थापित किया?
o: It established the truth that it was no longer possible to rule India without the wishes of Indians
It proved that the nationalist leadership was entirely dependent on British managing agencies
It established that constitutional agitations within legislative councils were the only effective tools
It proved that the rural peasantry completely lacked any baseline national consciousness
e: Detailed Explanation: The scale and intensity of the 1942 upsurge demonstrated that national consciousness had penetrated to the absolute roots of society, establishing the truth that the British could no longer govern India without consulting the wishes of the Indian people.

qe: What was the great historical significance of the Quit India Movement regarding the ultimate agenda of the national freedom struggle?
qh: राष्ट्रीय स्वतंत्रता संघर्ष के अंतिम एजेंडे के संबंध में भारत छोड़ो आंदोलन का बड़ा ऐतिहासिक महत्व क्या था?
o: The movement placed the demand for absolute independence on the immediate, non-negotiable agenda of the national movement
It successfully forced the British Parliament to immediately re-enact the dyarchy system
It compelled the Congress Working Committee to formally accept the separate electorates framework
It limited all future political agitations strictly to municipal budget modifications inside towns
e: Detailed Explanation: The historic significance of Quit India was that it elevated the national discourse past minor concessions. It placed the demand for total independence on the immediate, non-negotiable agenda, ensuring there could be no political retreat.

qe: During the central executive guidelines of the Government of India Act 1919, what specific bicameral houses had replaced the old unicameral Imperial Legislative Council?
qh: भारत सरकार अधिनियम 1919 के केंद्रीय कार्यकारी दिशानिर्देशों के तहत, किन विशिष्ट द्विसदनीय सदनों ने पुरानी एकसदनीय इंपीरियल लेजिस्लेटिव काउंसिल का स्थान लिया था?
o: The Central Legislative Assembly (lower house) and the Council of State (upper house)
The House of Commons and the House of Lords structural branches
The British Indian Association and the All India Kisan Sabha chambers
The固定 legislative councils and the provincial circuit benches
e: Detailed Explanation: The 1919 Act introduced a bicameral central legislature consisting of a lower house named the Central Legislative Assembly and an upper house named the Council of State, introducing the initial structural principle of a double-chamber parliament.

qe: The 'Lee Commission' was appointed by the colonial administration in 1923 to investigate which structural crisis within the Raj's executive apparatus?
qh: औपनिवेशिक प्रशासन द्वारा 1923 में 'ली कमीशन' (Lee Commission) की नियुक्ति राज के कार्यकारी तंत्र के भीतर किस संरचनात्मक संकट की जांच के लिए की गई थी?
o: The failure of the Raj to recruit an adequate number of British officers for the superior civil services
The grid deadlock tracking the implementation of separate electorates for intermediate castes
The total structural collapse of financial revenue collections inside the Bihar delta plains
The historical failure of the local municipal institutional boards to fund primary schools
e: Detailed Explanation: The Lee Commission investigated the recruitment crisis within the superior civil services, looking specifically into the failure of the Raj to attract and recruit enough British officers to maintain the European core of the administration.

qe: Under the judicial framework of the Cornwallis Code of 1793, what structural reform was firmly established regarding the legal accountability of colonial officials for official acts?
qh: 1793 के कॉर्नवॉलिस कोड के न्यायिक ढांचे के तहत, आधिकारिक कार्यों के लिए औपनिवेशिक अधिकारियों की कानूनी जवाबदेही के संबंध में कौन सा संरचनात्मक सुधार दृढ़ता से स्थापित किया गया था?
o: Government officials were made answerable to the civil courts for actions done in their official capacity
They were granted absolute permanent immunity from any civil or criminal litigation oversight
They could only be tried inside secret military tribunals managed by the British Parliament directly
Their official actions were subject to mandatory verification and clearance by local village panchayats
e: Don't Mention Page: A groundbreaking feature of the Cornwallis Code of 1793 was the introduction of administrative legal accountability. It explicitly established that government officials could no longer claim sovereign immunity and were answerable to the civil courts for any actions or abuses committed in their official capacity.

qe: What definitive change did the Government of India Act of 1858 introduce regarding the supervisory control over the administration of India after the dissolution of the East India Company?
qh: भारत सरकार अधिनियम 1858 ने ईस्ट इंडिया कंपनी के विघटन के बाद भारत के प्रशासन पर पर्यवेक्षी नियंत्रण के संबंध में क्या निश्चित परिवर्तन किया?
o: The power to govern was transferred to the British Crown, to be wielded through a Secretary of State answerable to the British Parliament
The absolute command of revenues was handed directly to the non-official Indian members of the Legislative Council
The administration was completely subordinated to a newly created Federal Court based in Allahabad
The permanent legal re-establishment of the traditional Mughal legal system under a Deputy Nizam
e: Detailed Explanation: The Act of 1858 dissolved the East India Company and transferred governance directly to the British Crown. This power was exercised through a newly created cabinet post, the Secretary of State for India, who was assisted by a 15-member council and made directly answerable to the British Parliament.

qe: In February 1943, Mahatma Gandhi initiated a historic fast while in prison. Against what structural issue was this hunger strike primarily directed?
qh: फरवरी 1943 में, महात्मा गांधी ने जेल में रहते हुए एक ऐतिहासिक उपवास शुरू किया था। यह भूख हड़ताल मुख्य रूप से किस संरचनात्मक मुद्दे के खिलाफ निर्देशित थी?
o: The institutional violence of the colonial State
The refusal of the Congress to adopt the two-nation theory
The implementation of separate electorates for minority communities
The continuous entry of British managing agencies into coastal shipping
e: Detailed Explanation: Gandhi started his fast in February 1943 as a powerful answer to the government's exhortation to condemn popular unrest. The fast was explicitly directed against the high-handed structural violence of the colonial State itself.

qe: What major constitutional development occurred within the Viceroy’s Executive Council as a direct result of public outrage during Gandhi's 1943 fast?
qh: गांधी के 1943 के उपवास के दौरान जन आक्रोश के सीधे परिणाम के रूप में वायसराय की कार्यकारी परिषद (Viceroy’s Executive Council) के भीतर कौन सा बड़ा संवैधानिक घटनाक्रम हुआ था?
o: Three Indian members of the Viceroy's executive council resigned in protest
The council was immediately dissolved and replaced by a constituent assembly
The Governor-General surrendered his absolute veto power to the Premier
The absolute unification of the executive council with the Muslim League front
e: Detailed Explanation: As protests, hartals, and strikes erupted at home and abroad during the fast, the moral pressure forced exactly three prominent members of the Viceroy’s Executive Council to resign from their seats in protest.

qe: Which of the following was NOT an administrative or political achievement of Mahatma Gandhi's 1943 prison fast?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा महात्मा गांधी के 1943 के जेल उपवास का प्रशासनिक या राजनीतिक परिणाम नहीं था?
o: The British government formally agreed to grant immediate dominion status to the Indian Union
Public morale across the country was significantly raised
Anti-British feeling among different sections of society was heightened
An important opportunity was provided for renewed nationalist political activity
e: Detailed Explanation: The fast successfully raised public morale, heightened anti-British sentiments, and exposed the government's high-handedness. However, it did not compel the British government to grant immediate dominion status.

qe: On which specific date did the All India Muslim League officially observe 'Pakistan Day' during the peak of the wartime political vacuum in 1943?
qh: 1943 में युद्धकालीन राजनीतिक शून्य के चरम के दौरान अखिल भारतीय मुस्लिम लीग ने आधिकारिक तौर पर किस विशिष्ट तिथि को 'पाकिस्तान दिवस' (Pakistan Day) मनाया था?
o: March 23, 1943
February 14, 1931
August 31, 1920
e: Detailed Explanation: While the mainstream national movement was grappling with leadership arrests and the post-fast scenario, the Muslim League officially observed Pakistan Day on March 23, 1943.

qe: The veteran Congress leader C. Riveragopalachari prepared a specialized scheme in 1944 to bridge the constitutional deadlock. What did this plan structurally represent?
qh: दिग्गज कांग्रेस नेता सी. राजगोपालाचारी ने 1944 में संवैधानिक गतिरोध को दूर करने के लिए एक विशेष योजना तैयार की थी। यह योजना संरचनात्मक रूप से किसे दर्शाती थी?
o: A tacit acceptance of the Muslim League’s demand for Pakistan to secure Congress-League cooperation
The complete, absolute validation of Lord Birkenhead's constitutional challenges
A legislative blueprint to permanently integrate the Kingdom of Nepal into British India
The mandatory conversion of all provincial legislative councils into non-elected bodies
e: Detailed Explanation: The CR Plan (1944) formulated a strategy for Congress-League cooperation. It was significant because it represented a tacit, realistic acceptance of the Muslim League's underlying demand for a separate Pakistan by a frontline Congress leader.

qe: Under the terms of the 1944 CR Plan, what baseline political obligation was demanded from the Muslim League in return for a post-war plebiscite?
qh: 1944 के सीआर प्लान (CR Plan) की शर्तों के तहत, युद्ध के बाद जनमत संग्रह के बदले मुस्लिम लीग से कौन सी बुनियादी राजनीतिक प्रतिबद्धता मांगी गई थी?
o: The Muslim League had to endorse the Congress demand for independence and cooperate in forming a provisional central government
The League had to completely dissolve its organizational infrastructure across all provinces
The mandatory rejection of separate communal electorates inside the central assembly
To provide extensive financial credit inputs to support the newly established national schools
e: Detailed Explanation: The CR Plan stipulated that the Muslim League must endorse the Congress demand for independence and actively cooperate with the Congress in establishing a provisional interim government at the center.

qe: According to the territorial arrangements of the 1944 CR Plan, which specific geographical zones were designated to undergo a popular plebiscite after the war?
qh: 1944 के सीआर प्लान के क्षेत्रीय समझौतों के अनुसार, युद्ध के बाद किन विशिष्ट भौगोलिक क्षेत्रों में जनमत संग्रह (plebiscite) कराया जाना तय किया गया था?
o: The Muslim majority areas in North-West and North-East India
The entire unified baseline territory of the Bengal and Bombay Presidencies
Only the princely states that refused to allotment 52 seats in the Council of States
The landlocked alluvial plains of Bihar and the Chhotanagpur tribal belt exclusively
e: Detailed Explanation: The CR Plan proposed that after the conclusion of World War II, the entire population residing within the Muslim-majority areas of North-West and North-East India would decide via a democratic plebiscite whether to separate.

qe: What structural condition was appended to the 1944 CR Plan layout regarding the activation of its constitutional terms?
qh: 1944 की सीआर योजना के खाके में उसकी संवैधानिक शर्तों के लागू होने के संबंध में कौन सी संरचनात्मक शर्त जोड़ी गई थी?
o: The terms would be operative only if England transferred full powers to India
The proposals were dependent on the unique financial validation of the Aligarh School
The terms required the immediate, absolute partition of the country before the war ended
The plan would function only within the non-votable items of the 1919 Act
e: Detailed Explanation: The CR Plan featured an essential safeguard for national integrity: all its terms and compromise clauses would become operational only if England transferred full, absolute sovereign powers to India.

qe: Why did Mohammad Ali Jinnah strongly object to the provisions of the 1944 CR Plan, leading to the failure of his discussions with Gandhi?
qh: मोहम्मद अली जिन्ना ने 1944 के सीआर प्लान के प्रावधानों पर कड़ा ऐतराज क्यों जताया, जिससे गांधी के साथ उनकी बातचीत विफल हो गई?
o: He wanted the Congress to accept the two-nation theory, opposed a common center, and wanted only Muslims to vote in the plebiscite
He demanded that the plebiscite be expanded to include all Hindu majority provinces
He vehemently objected to the creation of separate Muslim-majority units in Sindh
He sought to protect the executive veto powers of the central Governor-General permanently
e: Detailed Explanation: Jinnah rejected the CR Plan because he demanded that the Congress officially acknowledge the two-nation theory first. He also opposed a common central machinery for subjects like defence, and insisted that only the Muslim population of the targeted areas vote in the plebiscite, not the entire population.

qe: Which prominent group of nationalist leaders fiercely condemned the CR Plan, rejecting any compromise on the territorial integrity of the Indian Union?
qh: राष्ट्रवादी नेताओं के किस प्रमुख समूह ने भारतीय संघ की क्षेत्रीय अखंडता पर किसी भी समझौते को अस्वीकार करते हुए सीआर प्लान (CR Plan) की तीखी निंदा की थी?
o: Hindu leaders led by Vir Savarkar
The Congress Socialist Party led by Jayaprakash Narayan
The underground active cadres of the Forward Bloc
The radical ulema networks belonging to the Deoband school
e: Detailed Explanation: The proposals of the CR Plan faced stiff opposition from right-wing nationalist circles. Hindu leaders, spearheaded by Vir Savarkar, heavily condemned the plan for making concessions toward partition.

qe: The Desai-Liaqat Pact was formulated as a draft proposal to establish an interim government at the center. Which respective legislative positions did these two leaders hold at that time?
qh: केंद्र में एक अंतरिम सरकार स्थापित करने के लिए एक मसौदा प्रस्ताव के रूप में देसाई-लियाकत समझौते को तैयार किया गया था। उस समय इन दोनों नेताओं के पास कौन से विधायी पद थे?
o: Bhulabhai Desai was the leader of the Congress Party, and Liaqat Ali Khan was the deputy leader of the Muslim League in the Central Legislative Assembly
Desai was the Speaker of the Federal Assembly, and Liaqat was an Executive Councillor
Bhulabhai Desai was the Premier of Bombay, and Liaqat Khan was the Secretary of State
Both were non-official nominated elite members representing the zamindari interests of Bihar
e: Detailed Explanation: The pact was an informal negotiation inside the legislature. Bhulabhai Desai was the leader of the Congress Party in the Central Legislative Assembly, while Liaqat Ali Khan served as the deputy leader of the Muslim League in that same Assembly.

qe: What structural composition was proposed for the central legislature under the terms of the Desai-Liaqat Pact draft?
qh: देसाई-लियाकत समझौते (Desai-Liaqat Pact) की शर्तों के तहत केंद्रीय विधायिका के लिए किस संरचनात्मक संरचना का प्रस्ताव किया गया था?
o: An equal number of persons nominated by the Congress and the League, along with 20% reserved seats for minorities
An absolute official majority composed entirely of European administrative bureaucrats
Seats allocated strictly based on the military recruitment importance of Punjab and Bombay
A complete replacement of the legislative councils by the executive committee of the landholders
e: Detailed Explanation: The Desai-Liaqat draft proposed an interim central framework based on parity: it called for an equal number of nominees from both the Congress and the League in the legislature, supplemented by exactly 20% reserved seats for minority communities.

qe: Although no final settlement could be reached on the lines of the Desai-Liaqat Pact, what far-reaching political consequence did it produce for future negotiations?
qh: यद्यपि देसाई-लियाकत समझौते की तर्ज पर कोई अंतिम समझौता नहीं हो सका, फिर भी इसने भविष्य की वार्ताओं के लिए कौन सा दूरगामी राजनीतिक परिणाम पैदा किया?
o: It established a sort of parity between the Congress and the Muslim League
It caused the immediate legal dissolution of the All India Muslim League infrastructure
It forced the Congress Working Committee to completely abandon the goal of Purna Swaraj
It led to the total elimination of separate communal electorates from provincial councils
e: Detailed Explanation: Even though the pact failed to be implemented, the fact that a baseline structural 'parity' between the Congress and the Muslim League was formally proposed and accepted during discussions had deep, far-reaching consequences for later constitutional deadlocks.

qe: When the war in Europe terminated in May 1945, the British Conservative government led by Churchill felt keen to find an immediate solution to the Indian constitutional crisis. What primary domestic reason drove this eagerness?
